irs-eitc.name: IRS estimate of unclaimed EITC
irs-eitc.outcome: About one in five eligible taxpayers miss the credit; up to $7,830 with children for tax year 2024; average $2,743 for 2023
irs-eitc.limits: IRS estimate, not an audit; page is marked archival (January 2025 release).
irs-eitc.locator: "roughly one in five eligible taxpayers miss out on claiming this valuable credit"

irs-vita.name: IRS Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA)
irs-vita.outcome: Free tax preparation by trained volunteers, mainly for people earning about $70,244 or less
irs-vita.limits: Services and income limits vary by site; seasonal.
irs-vita.locator: "the IRS does not set a program-wide income limit"

stockton-seed.name: Stockton Economic Empowerment Demonstration (SEED)
stockton-seed.outcome: $500 a month for 24 months to 125 people; recipients found full-time work at more than twice the rate of non-recipients in year one; food was about 37% of spending
stockton-seed.limits: One city, 125 recipients, preliminary first-year results, philanthropic funding; scale and cost are contested.
stockton-seed.locator: "distributed $500 a month for 24 months to 125 recipients"

maf-lending-circles.name: Mission Asset Fund lending circles
maf-lending-circles.outcome: Members with no or poor credit almost twice as likely as a comparison group to raise their score 20+ points in 10 months
maf-lending-circles.limits: Quasi-experimental study of 260 participants; one organization; no-score members drive the large average gain.
maf-lending-circles.locator: "almost twice as likely as those in the control group to succeed"

dollar-for.name: Dollar For charity care help
dollar-for.outcome: Free nonprofit that files hospital charity care applications; more than $38 million in medical bills cleared since 2019
dollar-for.limits: Figures are the group's own, reported through a partner nonprofit; eligibility limits are set by each hospital.
dollar-for.locator: "They don't pay your bills; they get the hospital to forgive them."

dollar-for-site.name: Dollar For patient program
dollar-for-site.outcome: Prepares and sends charity care applications and follows up with the hospital, free to patients
dollar-for-site.limits: Testimonials on the page are self-reported; no overall total stated there.

cr-negotiate.name: Consumer Reports survey on negotiating TV and internet bills
cr-negotiate.outcome: Of 176,000+ members, 70% had tried to negotiate; 80% of those got a perk; about a quarter cut bills by up to $50 a month
cr-negotiate.limits: Self-reported by Consumer Reports members, who are not a representative sample; 2018 data.
cr-negotiate.locator: "80 percent—were able to get one or more perks"

ftc-click-to-cancel.name: Federal Trade Commission click-to-cancel rule vacated
ftc-click-to-cancel.outcome: Eighth Circuit struck down the rule on July 8, 2025, days before it took effect, on procedural grounds; "some states, including California, have laws that require easy cancellation"
ftc-click-to-cancel.limits: Law-firm summary; the FTC could restart the rule; state laws vary.
ftc-click-to-cancel.locator: "failed to properly follow its own rulemaking procedures"

ctc-2021.name: 2021 expanded child tax credit and record-low child poverty
ctc-2021.outcome: After the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) expanded the child tax credit, child poverty under the Census Bureau's Supplemental Poverty Measure fell from 9.7% in 2020 to 5.2% in 2021; the expansion kept 2.1 million children out of poverty
ctc-2021.limits: Expansion was temporary and lapsed; Census says 2019-2024 SPM rates are being revised after a threshold coding error found in July 2026; the policy is contested.

myfriendben.name: MyFriendBen benefits screener
myfriendben.outcome: Free screener; the developers say it helped more than 55,000 households apply for $33 million in benefits in two years
myfriendben.limits: Figures are self-reported by the developer; one state at first.
myfriendben.locator: "helped more than 55,000 Colorado households apply for $33 million in benefits"

credit-union-pal.name: Credit union payday alternative loans (PALs I and II)
credit-union-pal.outcome: Federal credit unions may offer loans up to $2,000 over 1 to 12 months with interest capped at 28%
credit-union-pal.limits: Credit unions are not required to offer them; membership rules apply; cap tied to the NCUA ceiling.
credit-union-pal.locator: Comparison table: PALs II "$2,000 maximum", 28% interest cap

bls-union.name: Bureau of Labor Statistics union members summary, 2025
bls-union.outcome: Full-time union members earned a median $1,404 a week versus $1,174 for nonunion workers; membership rate 10.0%
bls-union.limits: Raw gap; BLS notes it reflects occupation, industry, region and other factors; 2025 data affected by a shutdown.
bls-union.locator: "union members had median usual weekly earnings of $1,404 in 2025"

getcalfresh.name: Code for America GetCalFresh
getcalfresh.outcome: Cut the food benefit application from about 45 minutes to under 10 and raised application rates in counties using it
getcalfresh.limits: Organization's own announcement; application time is not the same as approval.
getcalfresh.locator: "slashed the time it takes to submit an application" to under 10 minutes

snap-participation.name: USDA SNAP participation estimate, FY 2022
snap-participation.outcome: SNAP served 88 percent of eligible individuals; elderly people participated at lower rates
snap-participation.limits: Survey-based estimate; not comparable with earlier years due to new weights.
snap-participation.locator: "SNAP served 88 percent of all eligible individuals in FY 22"

usac-lifeline.name: USAC Lifeline eligibility rules
usac-lifeline.outcome: Households at or below 135% of federal poverty guidelines ($21,546 for one person in 2026) or on SNAP, Medicaid, Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and others qualify; one benefit per household
usac-lifeline.limits: The standard monthly discount amount was not stated on the opened page.
usac-lifeline.locator: "Only one Lifeline benefit is allowed per household."

subscription-survey.name: C+R Research subscription spending survey
subscription-survey.outcome: People guessed $86 a month on subscriptions but itemized $219; 42% had kept paying for one they stopped using
subscription-survey.limits: Online survey of 1,000 self-reporting consumers by a market research firm.
subscription-survey.locator: "a whopping $133 higher than their original estimate"

preston-cwb.name: Preston community wealth building
preston-cwb.outcome: City council began steering its purchasing toward local firms around 2012-13
preston-cwb.limits: The opened page gives no spending figures for Preston; a local opposition leader called it a "marketing gimmick"; contested.
preston-cwb.locator: Preston section; council aimed to localise procurement spend

chca-coop.name: Cooperative Home Care Associates
chca-coop.outcome: Worker-owned home care company employing more than 2,200 staff, with eight employees on its board
chca-coop.limits: The opened page is a stub; wages and ownership terms were not confirmed there.
chca-coop.locator: "Eight employees are represented in the Board"

cfpb-ymyg.name: CFPB Your Money, Your Goals toolkit
cfpb-ymyg.outcome: Printable booklets and tools for working through money stress and goals
cfpb-ymyg.limits: Built for organizations that coach people; you print your own copies.
cfpb-ymyg.locator: Toolkit and booklets section; "print as handout"

bls-oews.name: Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
bls-oews.outcome: Publishes employment and wage estimates each year for about 830 occupations, including for metropolitan and nonmetropolitan areas
bls-oews.limits: Estimates are averages for an occupation and area, not what any one employer pays.
bls-oews.locator: "employment and wage estimates annually for approximately 830 occupations"
